- @@INLINE_CODE_2DB10F42_0000@@: Weka upana wa mstatili.
    - @@INLINE_CODE_56CE7E02_0001@@: Weka urefu wa mstatili.
    - @@INLINE_CODE_090BDE61_0002@@: Rudisha eneo (\\( \text@@PLACEHOLDER_384DF13D_0000@@ \times \text@@PLACEHOLDER_EB0A01A2_0001@@ \\)).
    - @@INLINE_CODE_8EB66441_0003@@: Rudisha mzunguko \\( 2(\text@@PLACEHOLDER_31D9B3BB_0002@@ + \text@@PLACEHOLDER_0AA9CE13_0003@@) \\).
    - @@INLINE_CODE_7046F14E_0004@@: Rudisha diagonal \\( \sqrt{\text@@PLACEHOLDER_A624E72C_0004@@^2 + \text@@PLACEHOLDER_BDDD505A_0005@@^2} \\).
    - @@INLINE_CODE_40B2D0BB_0005@@: Rudisha mfuatano wa herufi unaowakilisha umbo kwa kutumia mistari ya @@INLINE_CODE_B427D47D_0006@@. Idadi ya mistari inapaswa kuwa sawa na urefu na idadi ya @@INLINE_CODE_6E336FC7_0007@@ katika kila mstari inapaswa kuwa sawa na upana. Kila mstari unapaswa kumalizika na mstari mpya (@@INLINE_CODE_3099A8BB_0008@@). Ikiwa upana au urefu ni mkubwa zaidi ya @@INLINE_CODE_0DA909F8_0009@@, hii inapaswa kurudisha mfuatano wa herufi: @@INLINE_CODE_E7F87B09_0010@@.
    - @@INLINE_CODE_B37F0267_0011@@: Inachukua umbo lingine (mraba au mstatili) kama hoja. Rudisha idadi ya mara ambazo umbo lililotumwa linaweza kufikia ndani ya umbo hili (bila kuzungusha). Kwa mfano, mstatili wenye upana wa @@INLINE_CODE_DF2E491A_0012@@ na urefu wa @@INLINE_CODE_158FE7F4_0013@@ unaweza kufikia mraba mbili zenye pande za @@INLINE_CODE_9558C885_0014@@.

Broj redova treba da odgovara visini, a broj @@INLINE_CODE_6E336FC7_0007@@ u svakom redu mora odgovarati širini. Svaki red mora biti završen novim redom (@@INLINE_CODE_3099A8BB_0008@@). Ako je širina ili visina veća od @@INLINE_CODE_0DA909F8_0009@@, ovo treba da vrati niz znakova: @@INLINE_CODE_E7F87B09_0010@@.

Na primer, pravougaonik širine @@INLINE_CODE_DF2E491A_0012@@ i visine @@INLINE_CODE_158FE7F4_0013@@ može da primi dva kvadrata sa stranicama od @@INLINE_CODE_9558C885_0014@@.
